item: {"addr": "0x140177f9c", "comment": "ExtraLeveledCreature (45) on load: new resolved base from 14375; the actor's current base is destroyed (vfunc 0) only if TESDataHandler::IsTemporaryFormID(base->formID): a permanent base (a copy swapped to the owner's face record) is kept."}

{"addr": "0x1402195f0", "comment": "Root walk of faceNPC (+0x1F0): rcx = current link, rax = its faceNPC. A fault here with rax == rcx means the faulting pointer came from the previous link's +0x1F0 (or the base's own when first)."}

{"addr": "0x14064df30", "comment": "AddressLib 36460. Destroys a form: at once (TESDataHandler 0x1B6EA0 removes it from the form map, then vfunc 0 delete) outside a job or during a load, else queued in the collector's list for later deletion. No temporary-ID check: callers must pass a form they own."}

{"addr": "0x1401DCBA0", "comment": "Leveled actor resolve for a reference (a1 = original NPC's TESActorBaseData, a2 = ref): rolls the NPC's LVLN template (14752), builds a new temporary NPC copied from the ref's current base (factory vfunc 0x178) then CopyFromTemplateForms(pick), records ExtraLeveledCreature {original = current base, template = pick} (20231) and SetObjectReference(new). Then (a3 == 0) resets inventory/AI state, SwitchRace."}
{"addr": "0x1401696D0", "comment": "Sets ExtraLeveledCreature (45) {originalBase +0x10, templateBase +0x18}; both null removes it."}
{"addr": "0x1403016e0", "comment": "AddressLib 20231. For an NPC base: sets (a2,a3 non-null: flag 0x40000 via 14608) or clears the reference's ExtraLeveledCreature (11811-like wrapper)."}

{"addr": "0x1406762b1", "comment": "The current base handed to the GC (36460) is destroyed without a temporary check: the engine assumes a leveled actor's current base is the temporary one it built. A copy given a permanent face record (coop SetActorBaseFormId) loses that record here: playtest 2026-11-22 crash 3 (EncWolf 23ABE)."}
{"addr": "0x1403016e0", "comment": "AddressLib 20231. For an NPC base: sets (a2,a3 non-null: flag 0x40000 via 14608) or clears (vfunc 0x58) the reference's ExtraLeveledCreature through 0x1401696D0."}

{"addr": "0x140678a50", "comment": "AddressLib 37323. A leveled actor (ExtraLeveledCreature original != current base) that may respawn (CanRespawn unless a2 == -1): back to the original base, clears the extra, destroys the current base (GC 36460, no temporary check), and rolls again (0x1401DCBA0). Callers: cell respawn loop 0x1402CF9D0, ResetReference native, ref alias init, quest start, script reset."}
{"addr": "0x1402CF9D0", "comment": "Per reference of a cell list: a persistent or dead-in-editor NPC that may respawn (37290) is re-rolled (37323); other refs pick their leveled base (20232)."}

{"addr": "0x1402D2CB0", "comment": "AddressLib 19286. Cell reset functor per reference (from TESObjectCELL 19084): temporary refs are deleted; an actor past its respawn time goes through ResetReference 37292 (which re-rolls a leveled actor and destroys its current base)."}
